description: This file defines the DefaultAmqp10Config class, which implements the Amqp10Config interface. It provides configuration settings related to AMQP 1.0 messaging, such as timeout durations, throttling, backoff strategies, and connection parameters for the messaging service.

classes.name: DefaultAmqp10Config
classes.description: Implements the Amqp10Config interface to provide configuration settings for AMQP 1.0 messaging, initialized from a scoped configuration and exposing various parameters related to timeouts, throttling, backoff, and connection management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultAmqp10Config from a given Config object, applying fallback and default values.

methods.name: isConsumerRateLimitEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether consumer rate limiting is enabled.

methods.name: getConsumerMaxInFlight
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of messages that can be in-flight for the consumer.

methods.name: getConsumerRedeliveryExpectationTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration to expect for consumer message redelivery.

methods.name: getConsumerThrottlingConfig
methods.description: Provides the throttling configuration for the consumer.

methods.name: getProducerCacheSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the producer cache.

methods.name: getBackOffConfig
methods.description: Returns the backoff configuration used for retries.

methods.name: getMaxQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum queue size for messages.

methods.name: getPublisherParallelism
methods.description: Returns the degree of parallelism for message publishing.

methods.name: getGlobalConnectTimeout
methods.description: Returns the global connection timeout duration.

methods.name: getGlobalSendTimeout
methods.description: Returns the global send timeout duration.

methods.name: getGlobalRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the global request timeout duration.

methods.name: getGlobalPrefetchPolicyAllCount
methods.description: Returns the global prefetch policy count.
